spanish: ¿Por qué flota mi cepillo de dientes?

spanish: He contado las estrellas. Me salen tres.
lonapse_text: eH odatnoc sal sallertse. eM nelas sert.
english: I counted the stars. I got three.
I already let go. Now what?

spanish: Si giramos la nave, ¿abajo pasa a ser arriba?
lonapse_text: iS somarig al evan, ¿ojaba asap a res abirra?
english: If we turn the ship, does down become up?

spanish: Entonces estoy del revés. Qué bien.
lonapse_text: secnotnE yotse led séver. éuQ neib.

spanish: ¿Dónde está el retrovisor de este cohete?
lonapse_text: ¿ednóD átse le rosivorter ed etse etehoc?
english: Where's the rear-view mirror on this rocket?

spanish: ¿A qué huele el espacio? Aquí huele a queso.
lonapse_text: ¿A éuq eleuh le oicapse? íuqA eleuh a oseuq.
english: What does space smell like? It smells like cheese in here.

spanish: Control, giramos. ¿Es normal? Dime que es normal.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, somarig. ¿sE lamron? emiD euq se lamron.
english: Control, we're spinning. Is that normal? Tell me it's normal.

spanish: Control, el combustible baja. ¿Por qué baja tan rápido?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, le elbitsubmoc ajab. ¿roP éuq ajab nat odipár?
english: Control, the fuel is dropping. Why is it dropping so fast?

spanish: Es normal con el motor encendido. Todo va bien.
lonapse_text: sE lamron noc le rotom odidnecne. odoT av neib.
english: That's normal with the engine running. All good.

spanish: Control, ¿seguro que este tornillo va aquí?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿oruges euq etse ollinrot av íuqa?
english: Control, are you sure this bolt goes here?

spanish: Si me duermo, ¿quién vigila las luces?
lonapse_text: iS em omreud, ¿néiuq aligiv sal secul?
english: If I fall asleep, who watches the lights?

spanish: Eso es justo lo que me preocupa.
lonapse_text: osE se otsuj ol euq em apucoerp.

spanish: Control, esto tiembla. Y yo también.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, otse albmeit. Y oy néibmat.
english: Control, this is shaking. And so am I.

spanish: Recibido. Los dos vais a estar bien.
lonapse_text: odibiceR. soL sod siav a ratse neib.

spanish: Control, me ofrezco para la próxima misión. Y para la siguiente.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, em oczerfo arap al amixórp nóisim. Y arap al etneiugis.
english: Control, I volunteer for the next mission. And the one after.

spanish: Giramos. Lo tengo, Control, ya lo freno.
lonapse_text: somariG. oL ognet, lortnoC, ay ol onerf.
english: We're spinning. I've got it, Control, slowing it down.

spanish: ¿Quién quiere salir primero a la superficie?
lonapse_text: ¿néiuQ ereiuq rilas oremirp a al eicifrepus?
english: Who wants to go out on the surface first?

spanish: Suelo cerca. Agarraos, que esto lo aterrizo yo.
lonapse_text: oleuS acrec. soarragA, euq otse ol ozirreta oy.
english: Ground's close. Hold on, I'm landing this.

spanish: Si nos perdemos, yo exploro primero.
lonapse_text: iS son somedrep, oy orolpxe oremirp.
english: If we get lost, I'll scout ahead first.

spanish: Control, ¿cuál es el sitio más lejano? Vamos allí.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿láuc se le oitis sám onajel? somaV ílla.
english: Control, what's the farthest place? Let's go there.

spanish: Primero volved a casa, por favor.
lonapse_text: oremirP devlov a asac, rop rovaf.

spanish: Sube la temperatura. He visto cosas peores. Seguimos.
lonapse_text: ebuS al arutarepmet. eH otsiv sasoc seroep. somiugeS.
english: Temperature's rising. I've seen worse. Carrying on.

spanish: Otra órbita, otra vista bonita. Nunca me canso.
lonapse_text: artO atibró, arto atsiv atinob. acnuN em osnac.
english: Another orbit, another pretty view. Never gets old.

spanish: La primera vez yo también lo tocaba todo.
lonapse_text: aL aremirp zev oy néibmat ol abacot odot.
english: The first time, I touched everything too.

spanish: Que ahora hay más botones de emergencia.
lonapse_text: euQ aroha yah sám senotob ed aicnegreme.
english: Now there are more emergency buttons.

spanish: Un golpe de nada. Los he tenido peores.
lonapse_text: nU eplog ed adan. soL eh odinet seroep.
english: Just a small bump. I've had worse.
Control, did you see that maneuver? Perfect.

spanish: La hemos visto. Un poco torcida.
lonapse_text: aL someh otsiv. nU ocop adicrot.
english: We saw it. A bit crooked.

spanish: Aterrizaje suave. Ni una taza en el suelo.
lonapse_text: ejazirretA evaus. iN anu azat ne le oleus.
english: Smooth landing. Not a single cup on the floor.

spanish: Pues no los toques. Aquí piloto yo.
lonapse_text: seuP on sol seuqot. íuqA otolip oy.
english: Then don't touch them. I'm the pilot here.

spanish: Agarraos, voy a girar la nave.
lonapse_text: soarragA, yov a rarig al evan.
english: Hold on, I'm going to turn the ship.

spanish: Es por la vista. Confiad en mí.
lonapse_text: sE rop al atsiv. daifnoC ne ím.
english: It's for the view. Trust me.

spanish: Control, orientado a prógrado. Todo listo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, odatneiro a odargórp. odoT otsil.

spanish: Control, esta nave se maneja de maravilla.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, atse evan es ajenam ed allivaram.
english: Control, this ship handles like a dream.
Because you're the one flying it.

spanish: ¿Habéis visto ese aterrizaje? Ni un rebote.
lonapse_text: ¿siébaH otsiv ese ejazirreta? iN nu etober.
english: Did you see that landing? Not one bounce.

spanish: Control, he ajustado los giroscopios. Creo que van mejor.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, eh odatsuja sol soipocsorig. oerC euq nav rojem.
english: Control, I tuned the gyros. I think they're better.

spanish: Eso no se arregla con cinta.
lonapse_text: osE on es algerra noc atnic.
english: That doesn't get fixed with tape.

spanish: Control, combustible equilibrado entre los tanques.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, elbitsubmoc odarbiliuqe ertne sol seuqnat.
english: Control, fuel balanced between the tanks.

spanish: Este ruido no salía en el manual.
lonapse_text: etsE odiur on aílas ne le launam.
english: This noise wasn't in the manual.

spanish: Claro. Primero le doy un golpecito.
lonapse_text: oralC. oremirP el yod nu oticeplog.
english: Sure. First I'll give it a little tap.

spanish: Control, he desmontado una pieza. Sobra un tornillo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, eh odatnomsed anu azeip. arboS nu ollinrot.
english: Control, I took a part apart. There's a spare bolt.

spanish: Sumando los tanques, nos queda bastante combustible.
lonapse_text: odnamuS sol seuqnat, son adeuq etnatsab elbitsubmoc.
english: Adding up the tanks, we have plenty of fuel left.

spanish: Más o menos. Lo calculé en una servilleta.
lonapse_text: sáM o sonem. oL éluclac ne anu atellivres.
english: More or less. I did the math on a napkin.

spanish: Control, todo funciona. Casi me da miedo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, odot anoicnuf. isaC em ad odeim.
english: Control, everything works. It's almost scary.

spanish: Control, tengo datos nuevos. Muchísimos datos.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ognet sotad soveun. somisíhcuM sotad.
english: Control, I have new data. So much data.

spanish: No pises esa roca. Es una muestra.
lonapse_text: oN sesip ase acor. sE anu artseum.
english: Don't step on that rock. It's a sample.

spanish: Para ti todas las rocas son muestras.
lonapse_text: araP it sadot sal sacor nos sartseum.
english: To you, every rock is a sample.
Can I measure how loud you snore?

spanish: Ya lo he medido. Es mucho.
lonapse_text: aY ol eh odidem. sE ohcum.
english: I already measured it. It's a lot.

spanish: Control, mi hipótesis es que el espacio es grande.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, im sisetópih se euq le oicapse se ednarg.
english: Control, my hypothesis is that space is big.
Copy. The data is coming in.

spanish: ¿Has guardado tu bocadillo en mi caja de muestras?
lonapse_text: ¿saH odadraug ut ollidacob ne im ajac ed sartseum?
english: Did you put your sandwich in my sample box?

spanish: Control, este suelo sabe a ciencia.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, etse oleus ebas a aicneic.
english: Control, this soil tastes like science.

spanish: Necesito a alguien para un experimento.
lonapse_text: otiseceN a neiugla arap nu otnemirepxe.
english: I need a volunteer for an experiment.

spanish: Eso es lo que quiero averiguar.
lonapse_text: osE se ol euq oreiuq raugireva.
english: That's what I want to find out.

spanish: Control, ¿a qué hora sirven la cena?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿a éuq aroh nevris al anec?
english: Control, what time is dinner served?

spanish: Cuando quieras. Hay puré en tubo.
lonapse_text: odnauC sareiuq. yaH érup ne obut.
english: Whenever you like. There's mash in a tube.

spanish: ¿Puedo hacer una foto por la ventana?
lonapse_text: ¿odeuP recah anu otof rop al anatnev?
english: Can I take a photo out the window?
And another? And a hundred more?
Good question. Hold it a little longer.
Is this included in the ticket?

spanish: Todo. Las estrellas, la vista, todo.
lonapse_text: odoT. saL sallertse, al atsiv, odot.
english: Everything. The stars, the view, all of it.
Control, it's beautiful! It's all beautiful!

spanish: Nos alegra oírlo. No toques nada.
lonapse_text: soN argela olrío. oN seuqot adan.
english: Glad to hear it. Don't touch anything.
Does food always float like this?

spanish: ¡Qué maravilla! Se lo voy a contar a todos.
lonapse_text: ¡éuQ allivaram! eS ol yov a ratnoc a sodot.

spanish: Control, ¿cuándo sale el próximo autobús a casa?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿odnáuc elas le omixórp súbotua a asac?
english: Control, when's the next bus home?
We're very close to the port.

spanish: Nuevo nodo en el plan de vuelo.
lonapse_text: oveuN odon ne le nalp ed oleuv.
english: New node in the flight plan.

spanish: Maniobra en menos de un minuto.
lonapse_text: arboinaM ne sonem ed nu otunim.
english: Maneuver in less than a minute.
Everything in order on the station?

spanish: Comprobad el puerto y la estructura.
lonapse_text: daborpmoC le otreup y al arutcurtse.
english: Check the port and the structure.

spanish: Recibido, lo vemos en el mapa.
lonapse_text: odibiceR, ol somev ne le apam.
english: Copy, we see it on the map.

spanish: Orientando la nave para la maniobra.
lonapse_text: odnatneirO al evan arap al arboinam.
english: Orienting the ship for the maneuver.

spanish: Puerto a la vista. Empezamos la aproximación.
lonapse_text: otreuP a al atsiv. somazepmE al nóicamixorpa.
english: Port in sight. Starting the approach.
We see you closing in. Speed?

spanish: Aproximación en curso. Despacio y recto.
lonapse_text: nóicamixorpA ne osruc. oicapseD y otcer.

spanish: Frenad un poco antes del contacto.
lonapse_text: danerF nu ocop setna led otcatnoc.

spanish: Cuidado con la velocidad de cierre.
lonapse_text: odadiuC noc al dadicolev ed erreic.

spanish: Recibido. Revisad que no falte nada.
lonapse_text: odibiceR. dasiveR euq on etlaf adan.
english: Copy. Check that nothing is missing.
Hard contact. Are you all right?

spanish: Entendido. Comprobad el puerto y seguid.
lonapse_text: odidnetnE. daborpmoC le otreup y diuges.
english: Understood. Check the port and carry on.

spanish: Dos naves, ahora una. Bien hecho.
lonapse_text: soD sevan, aroha anu. neiB ohceh.
english: Two ships, now one. Well done.
We hear you again. Welcome back.

spanish: Ya no brilla nada ahí fuera.
lonapse_text: aY on allirb adan íha areuf.

english: All in one piece. I think.
Still here, and in one piece.

spanish: Tenemos una maniobra nueva para vosotros.
lonapse_text: someneT anu arboinam aveun arap sortosov.
english: We have a new maneuver for you.

spanish: Revisad el nodo en el mapa.
lonapse_text: dasiveR le odon ne le apam.
english: Check the node on the map.
Have you seen the new node?
New plan. Can you check it?

spanish: Otro nodo. Me encantan los nodos.
lonapse_text: ortO odon. eM natnacne sol sodon.

spanish: Apuntando la maniobra en mi libreta.
lonapse_text: odnatnupA al arboinam ne im aterbil.
english: Writing the maneuver in my notebook.

spanish: Maniobra en breve. Orientad la nave.
lonapse_text: arboinaM ne everb. datneirO al evan.

spanish: Faltan pocos segundos para la maniobra.
lonapse_text: natlaF socop sodnuges arap al arboinam.
english: A few seconds to the maneuver.

spanish: Estación, ¿qué tal la vida a bordo?
lonapse_text: nóicatsE, ¿éuq lat al adiv a odrob?

spanish: No te alejes demasiado de la nave.
lonapse_text: oN et sejela odaisamed ed al evan.
english: Don't go too far from the ship.

spanish: Te seguimos de cerca. Todo bien.
lonapse_text: eT somiuges ed acrec. odoT neib.
english: We're watching you closely. All good.
Are you okay? That sounded hard.
Is that thing drifting away ours?

spanish: Parece que sí. No pasa nada, seguid.
lonapse_text: eceraP euq ís. oN asap adan, diuges.
english: Looks like it. No problem, carry on.

spanish: Algo pequeño se ha soltado. Nada grave.
lonapse_text: oglA oñeuqep es ah odatlos. adaN evarg.
english: Something small came loose. Nothing serious.

spanish: Recibido. Lo vemos en los datos.
lonapse_text: odibiceR. oL somev ne sol sotad.
english: Copy. We see it in the data.

spanish: Se ha caído una pieza. Creo que no la necesitábamos.
lonapse_text: eS ah odíac anu azeip. oerC euq on al somabátisecen.
english: A part fell off. I don't think we needed it.

spanish: Algo explotó ahí fuera, pero era pequeño.
lonapse_text: oglA ótolpxe íha areuf, orep are oñeuqep.
english: Something blew up out there, but it was small.
Something blew up! We lost a part!

spanish: Eso no era un ruido normal. Falta una pieza.
lonapse_text: osE on are nu odiur lamron. atlaF anu azeip.
english: That wasn't a normal noise. A part is missing.

spanish: Hemos perdido una pieza. Seguimos de una pieza... casi.
lonapse_text: someH odidrep anu azeip. somiugeS ed anu azeip... isac.
english: We lost a part. We're still in one piece... mostly.
Boom, boom, boom! Make it stop!
We're losing parts! Lots of parts!
Another one blew up! Control, help!
There's barely any ship left! Do something!

spanish: Control aquí. Hemos perdido los datos de una pieza.
lonapse_text: lortnoC íuqa. someH odidrep sol sotad ed anu azeip.
english: Control here. We lost the data from a part.
Breathe. Tell us what still works.

spanish: Vimos la explosión. ¿Está todo el mundo bien?
lonapse_text: somiV al nóisolpxe. ¿átsE odot le odnum neib?
english: We saw the explosion. Is everyone okay?

spanish: Recibido. Comprobad la presión de la cabina.
lonapse_text: odibiceR. daborpmoC al nóiserp ed al anibac.

spanish: Entendido. Olvidad la pieza y pilotad la nave.
lonapse_text: odidnetnE. dadivlO al azeip y datolip al evan.
english: Understood. Forget the part and fly the ship.

spanish: La batería está casi vacía. Apago lo que sobra.
lonapse_text: aL aíretab átse isac aícav. ogapA ol euq arbos.
english: The battery is almost empty. Shutting off what we don't need.

spanish: Desplegad los paneles solares, si los tenemos.
lonapse_text: dagelpseD sol selenap seralos, is sol somenet.
english: Deploy the solar panels, if we have any.

spanish: Queda poca carga. Apago todo menos la radio.
lonapse_text: adeuQ acop agrac. ogapA odot sonem al oidar.
english: Charge is low. Shutting down everything but the radio.
Good thinking. We need to hear you.

spanish: Las luces se apagan poco a poco.
lonapse_text: saL secul es nagapa ocop a ocop.

spanish: La pantalla parpadea. Eso no es buena señal.
lonapse_text: aL allatnap aedaprap. osE on se aneub lañes.
english: The screen is flickering. That's not a good sign.

spanish: Carga baja. Apagad lo que no uséis.
lonapse_text: agraC ajab. dagapA ol euq on siésu.
english: Low charge. Shut down what you're not using.

spanish: Batería baja. Esto ya no es broma.
lonapse_text: aíretaB ajab. otsE ay on se amorb.
english: Battery low. This is no joke now.

spanish: Bien. Ya podéis encender la cafetera.
lonapse_text: neiB. aY siédop rednecne al aretefac.
english: Good. You can turn the coffee maker back on.
Perfect. We see it here too.

spanish: La radio no contesta. Nadie nos oye.
lonapse_text: aL oidar on atsetnoc. eidaN son eyo.
english: The radio is silent. Nobody can hear us.

spanish: Sin conexión con Control. Seguimos por nuestra cuenta.
lonapse_text: niS nóixenoc noc lortnoC. somiugeS rop artseun atneuc.
english: No link with Control. We're on our own.

spanish: Solo hay ruido en la radio.
lonapse_text: oloS yah odiur ne al oidar.
english: There's only static on the radio.

spanish: Control, si nos oís, todo va bien... creo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, is son sío, odot av neib... oerc.
english: Control, if you can hear us, all is well... I think.

spanish: Ya no hay señal. Qué silencio.
lonapse_text: aY on yah lañes. éuQ oicnelis.

english: We'll have to decide without help.
No answer. We'll have to wait.
Control? Can you hear us now?

spanish: Recibido. Os oímos alto y claro.
lonapse_text: odibiceR. sO somío otla y oralc.
english: Copy. We hear you loud and clear.
Ship here. Are you still there?

spanish: Control a la nave. Hemos perdido a un miembro de la tripulación.
lonapse_text: lortnoC a al evan. someH odidrep a nu orbmeim ed al nóicalupirt.
english: Control to ship. We have lost a crew member.

spanish: Lo sentimos mucho. Siempre formará parte de esta misión.
lonapse_text: oL somitnes ohcum. erpmeiS áramrof etrap ed atse nóisim.
english: We are very sorry. They will always be part of this mission.

spanish: Un momento de silencio en la radio, por favor.
lonapse_text: nU otnemom ed oicnelis ne al oidar, rop rovaf.
english: A moment of radio silence, please.

spanish: Hoy hemos perdido a alguien. Seguid con cuidado.
lonapse_text: yoH someh odidrep a neiugla. diugeS noc odadiuc.
english: We lost someone today. Carry on carefully.

spanish: Confirmado. No hay respuesta. Lo sentimos.
lonapse_text: odamrifnoC. oN yah atseupser. oL somitnes.
english: Confirmed. There is no response. We are sorry.

spanish: Mantened la calma. Traed al resto a casa.
lonapse_text: denetnaM al amlac. dearT la otser a asac.
english: Stay calm. Bring the others home.

spanish: Hemos perdido a alguien. No hay palabras.
lonapse_text: someH odidrep a neiugla. oN yah sarbalap.
english: We lost someone. There are no words.

spanish: Control, se ha ido. No pudimos hacer nada.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, es ah odi. oN somidup recah adan.
english: Control, they're gone. There was nothing we could do.

spanish: Seguiremos adelante. Por quien no vuelve.
lonapse_text: someriugeS etnaleda. roP neiuq on evleuv.
english: We'll carry on. For the one who won't come back.
Did you see that out the window?
Do you sleep well up here?
Do you feel us spinning too?

spanish: Creo que alguien tocó algo otra vez.
lonapse_text: oerC euq neiugla ócot ogla arto zev.
english: I think someone touched something again.

spanish: ¿Cuántos cohetes se estrellaron antes de este?
lonapse_text: ¿sotnáuC setehoc es norallertse setna ed etse?
english: How many rockets crashed before this one?
Do you know how to fly this?

spanish: El manual dice que no toquemos nada.
lonapse_text: lE launam ecid euq on someuqot adan.
english: The manual says not to touch anything.
When we get back, I want a pizza.

spanish: ¿Por qué está tan callado el motor?
lonapse_text: ¿roP éuq átse nat odallac le rotom?
english: Why is the engine so quiet?

spanish: No mires el indicador de combustible.
lonapse_text: oN serim le rodacidni ed elbitsubmoc.
english: Don't look at the fuel gauge.
They floated into my mouth on their own.

spanish: ¿Quién ha tocado el botón de etapas?
lonapse_text: ¿néiuQ ah odacot le nótob ed sapate?

english: I just wanted to see if it worked.

spanish: Creo que me he dejado la luz encendida en casa.
lonapse_text: oerC euq em eh odajed al zul adidnecne ne asac.
english: I think I left the light on at home.

spanish: Pues la factura va a ser astronómica.
lonapse_text: seuP al arutcaf av a res acimónortsa.
english: Then the bill will be astronomical.

spanish: ¿Sabes por qué la Mun no tiene amigos?
lonapse_text: ¿sebaS rop éuq al nuM on eneit sogima?
english: Do you know why the Mun has no friends?

spanish: Porque siempre nos da la espalda.
lonapse_text: euqroP erpmeis son ad al adlapse.
english: Because it always turns its back on us.
If nobody watches us, are we still spinning?

spanish: Eso es demasiado profundo para esta cápsula.
lonapse_text: osE se odaisamed odnuforp arap atse aluspác.
english: That's too deep for this capsule.

spanish: Tu traje huele a queso viejo.
lonapse_text: uT ejart eleuh a oseuq ojeiv.
english: Your suit smells like old cheese.
Three, two, one, la la la!
Will you swap seats with me?

spanish: Por eso lo pregunto con educación.
lonapse_text: roP ose ol otnugerp noc nóicacude.

spanish: He contado los botones. Hay ciento doce.
lonapse_text: eH odatnoc sol senotob. yaH otneic ecod.
english: I counted the buttons. There are a hundred and twelve.
Yesterday there were a hundred and eleven.

spanish: ¿Me das un poco de tu sándwich?
lonapse_text: ¿eM sad nu ocop ed ut hciwdnás?
english: Can I have some of your sandwich?

spanish: ¿Qué le dijo un cohete a otro cohete?
lonapse_text: ¿éuQ el ojid nu etehoc a orto etehoc?
english: What did one rocket say to the other rocket?

spanish: Has dejado la ventana llena de huellas.
lonapse_text: saH odajed al anatnev anell ed salleuh.
english: You left fingerprints all over the window.

spanish: Mi madre cree que trabajo en una oficina.
lonapse_text: iM erdam eerc euq ojabart ne anu anicifo.
english: My mom thinks I work in an office.

spanish: Técnicamente, esto es una oficina muy alta.
